capabilities: translate community-plugin interfaces, settings, and commands
reuse shared published translations across users
request localization of missing text and sync updates
re-verify translation compatibility after plugin updates
optionally patch plugin files with verified translations (desktop)
disambiguation: Not a note translator; it localizes other community plugins' interfaces and does not translate your notes or web pages.
extras: Registration is invite-only (email, Discord, or WeChat); translations are mostly machine-generated and not human proofread; versions below 1.0.0 are public betas.
problem: Most Obsidian community plugins ship English-only interfaces, leaving non-English users with untranslated settings, commands, and buttons.

relations.evidence: Connect a Trans-Hub account; no model or API key configuration is required.

summary: Localization tool that translates community-plugin interfaces, settings, and commands into your language via shared Trans-Hub translations.
